annotations.title: Compare loan options side by side

description: Compares two to five loan scenarios and reports which is cheapest by monthly payment and which by lifetime cost, separately, because they frequently are not the same loan. Use for 15-year versus 30-year, FHA versus conventional, competing lender quotes, or with and without discount points.

inputSchema.description: Compare loan options. Reports the cheapest by monthly payment and by lifetime cost separately, because they often differ.

scenarios.description: Two to five loan scenarios to compare side by side.

input.description: Full monthly housing cost: principal, interest, taxes, insurance, PMI and HOA.

annualInsurance.description: Annual homeowners insurance premium in US dollars.

annualInterestRatePercent.description: Annual nominal interest rate as a percentage, for example 6.5 for 6.5%.

downPaymentPercent.description: Down payment as a percentage of the purchase price, 0 to 100. Not a dollar amount.

homePrice.description: Purchase price of the home in US dollars.

loanTermYears.description: Loan term in years. Most US mortgages are 15 or 30.

loanType.description: Loan programme. Affects mortgage insurance and upfront fees.

monthlyExtraPrincipal.description: Additional principal paid each month. Shortens the loan rather than lowering the payment.

monthlyHoa.description: Monthly homeowners association dues in US dollars.

propertyTaxRatePercent.description: Annual property tax as a percentage of home value. Omit and pass `state` instead to use that state's average.

state.description: Full US state name, for example "Texas". Used to look up the average property tax rate. Either this or propertyTaxRatePercent is required.

label.description: Name for this option, for example "30-year fixed".

name: compare_loans

outputSchema.description: Side-by-side results for several loan scenarios and which wins on each measure.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

lowestMonthlyPayment.description: Label of the scenario with the lowest monthly payment.

lowestTotalCost.description: Label of the scenario with the lowest total cost.

lowestTotalInterest.description: Label of the scenario with the lowest total interest.

scenarios.description: One result per scenario, in the order supplied.

unanimous.description: Whether one scenario wins on every measure.

title: Compare loan options side by side
